annotations.title: RSU (employee shares) tax in the Netherlands

description: Tax on restricted stock units in the Netherlands: each vest is taxed as wages in Box 1 at the value on the vesting day (with or without the 30% ruling), and shares you keep fall into Box 3 the next year. Year by year, with sell-to-cover or keeping the shares.

grant_value.description: Value of the whole grant today, euros

keep_shares.description: Keep the net shares (true) or sell everything at vesting. Default false.

other_box3_assets.description: Other savings and investments, euros. Default 0.

salary.description: Gross base salary a year, euros

share_growth_percent.description: Expected share price change a year, %. Default 0.

vest_years.description: Years over which it vests evenly, 1-6. Default 4.

name: rsu_tax_netherlands
